artifactTooLarge: The artifact is too large (limit {mb} MB)
askCheeseBusy: A lot of people are asking right now. Try again later.
askCheeseDocsUnreadable: Ask Cheese can't read the docs right now. Try again later.
askCheeseNotOpen: Ask Cheese isn't open yet. Try again later.
devDocsOwnProjectsOnly: Developer docs are open only to Cheese's own projects
docsAssistantUnavailable: Cheese can't answer right now. Try again later.
docsIndexUnavailable: The documentation index can't be read right now. Try again later
docsNotAPage: Not a docs page: {page} (write the page name, such as accept or dev/turn)
pageAssetOutsidePage: {path} is outside the page's directory {dir}, so the preview cannot open it
pageAssetsMalformed: A page's files go as a list whose items each have path and content_b64
pageAssetsTooMany: A page can bring at most {n} files
previewPortSilent: Nothing is answering on the registered port, so the preview would be a blank frame. Start the app on 127.0.0.1, make sure it responds, then register the port.
previewTunnelDown: This environment hasn't opened its preview tunnel yet, so the preview can't reach the running app. Register the app with cheese serve <port> (that brings the tunnel up). To show someone a result, you can also name a file with cheese show — a web page, an image, or a document such as a report or a spreadsheet.
siteAssetMissing: The website is missing an asset: {path}. Put it in the website directory and have it accepted, then publish
siteAssetOutsideDir: A website asset reference points outside the published directory. Put the asset in the website directory
siteAssetUrlInvalid: An asset URL in the website's HTML is malformed
siteBuildRequired: The accepted version has no static website ready to publish. Prepare a static website that includes all its resources first, and submit it for review.
siteDirectoryChoose: Choose a static website directory in the project
siteDomainNotIsolated: The Site hosting domain must be separate from the platform's domain
siteDomainUnset: The Site hosting domain isn't configured yet
sitePublishForbidden: Only the project owner or a team admin can publish the website
siteRevisionChanged: The project's accepted version has changed. Refresh, then publish
siteSymlinkOrSubmodule: The website directory contains symbolic links or Git submodules. Put the files into the directory and have it accepted first
siteTooLarge: A website can have at most 2000 files and 100 MiB in total
